title: Tour
paragraphs: Without being confined to the house like a cat that has littered, Without living like a caged parrot taking the cage for the nation, The hero and heroine would take to going out on tours at least once a year. They followed this practice even in those days.
Taking their children along, they played in soothing ponds and beautiful parks, Enjoying the beauty in nature.
How sweet it is to know that The Tamils lived a complete life Even in the infancy of their history, Which Tolkāppiyam shows In its section on the wedded life!
> Seeking the pleasures of life, > Such as sports in rivers and tanks > And revelry in groves, > Beyond the bounds of their home soil, > Is part of the love career of the hero and heroine.
